features.description: Agent-first development platform with a shared agent harness co-trained with Gemini models; evolved from the Nov 2025 Antigravity IDE's Agent Manager into a standalone desktop app with no IDE.
Standalone agent-first desktop application on macOS, Linux, and Windows (v2.5+); synchronous and asynchronous agent work, artifact viewing, and multi-agent management.

Terminal-first TUI client for invoking, monitoring, and interacting with Antigravity agents; shares the same agent harness and settings as the desktop app and imports CLI conversations into the App via the @conversation dropdown.

features.feature: Gemini CLI transition and consumer tiers
features.description: Antigravity CLI launched May 19, 2026 (built in Go, asynchronous background workflows); on June 18, 2026 Gemini CLI and Gemini Code Assist stop serving free, Google AI Pro, and Ultra requests — those tiers are served by Antigravity instead (enterprise Gemini Code Assist licenses unchanged).
Official agent extensions for VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, Android Studio (BYO Agent/ACP), Visual Studio, Zed, Xcode, and Eclipse (Preview), plus the standalone agent-powered Antigravity IDE app.

Programmatic runtime (pip install google-antigravity) for building and deploying agents in apps and CI/CD: declarative tool policies (allow/deny/ask_user), system instructions/personas, custom Python tools, and MCP integration.
Antigravity App ships pre-installed on Googlebooks, with updates/reinstall via Google Play.

First-launch role picker (Software Engineering, Knowledge Work, Data & Analytics, Science, Design, Other) sets the App layout and starter prompts that install paired Marketplace plugins (Google Calendar, Drive, Slides, Figma).

features.feature: Setup import from other agentic tools
features.description: Bring over my setup imports MCP servers, skills, rules, and instructions from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.

Gemini 4 Carbon/Argon/Hydrogen, Gemini 3.8/3.7/3.6 Flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro, plus third-party Claude Sonnet 5.5 / Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.6 (Thinking) and GPT-OSS 120B in the model selector (third-party access noted as an Ultra-plan benefit).
Adjust reasoning effort per conversation turn (Low/Medium/High; Hydrogen adds Extra) via the model picker or /model in the CLI.
Orchestrator (Carbon)/(Argon) pairs a Gemini 4 planner that explores, plans, and reviews with Gemini 4 Hydrogen doing edits/builds/tests; included with Google AI Ultra, Argon with paid Pro plans.

Main agent invokes concurrent background subagents (invoke_subagent / define_subagent) with clean context, in isolated Git worktrees (branch), inherited, or shared workspaces, monitored via a subagent panel or /agents.
Ships research (codebase research/navigation), browser (web playtesting, screenshots, console/network inspection), and self (clone of the calling agent) subagents out of the box.

Reusable subagents as .md files with YAML frontmatter (tools, model tier, commandExecutionPolicy, mcpServers, skills/plugins), auto-discovered in .agents/agents/, ~/.gemini/config/agents/, or plugin bundles; lifecycle states running/idle/killed, inter-agent messaging, inherited permissions.

Boost runs an iterative implement-challenge-fix-verify pipeline for hard problems; Swarm splits broad work across named workers plus a verifier on a shared board; Teamwork runs long-horizon multi-milestone teams with a scoping interview and audit gates.

Agent writes a short Python script orchestrating many agents (e.g. one reviewer per changed file, test-then-fix pipelines); you approve the script, watch phases live, and save it to rerun; Google AI Pro and Ultra only.

/goal (run autonomously to completion), /grill-me (interview you before implementing), /schedule, /browser, /plugin, /plan, /diff, /tasks, /agents, /usage, /statusline, /resume, /rewind, /fork, /model, /context, /codesearch, /config, /keybindings; /boost, /swarm, /teamwork require a paid plan.

Track non-agentic background processes (shell commands, test suites, queries started via /btw): view stdout logs and terminate runaway processes; Alt+J teleports to the next subagent awaiting approval, Ctrl+K approves in place.
One-off timers or recurring cron schedules trigger agent invocations via /schedule and Scheduled Tasks, without manual invocation.
Define hooks in a simple JSON format to intercept and control the Antigravity agent's behavior (lifecycle hooks).
Structured visual reports — interactive implementation plans, unified multi-file diffs, and browser session recordings — inspected via Ctrl+R Artifact Review.
Compare Uncommitted/Branch/Agent-Edits views, stage/unstage/discard per file, commit with generated messages, amend, push, and comment on diff lines as feedback to the agent.

Built-in browser automation on personal accounts (v2.30.0+; parallel tabs, live cursor, one-click Stop, pause-and-resume sign-in handoff); CLI and business/enterprise accounts drive local Google Chrome v144+ via Chrome DevTools MCP with screenshots, console/network logs, performance traces, Lighthouse audits, and MP4 session recordings.

Fine-grained action(target) rules — read_file, write_file, read_url, execute_url, download_url, command (incl. regex:), mcp — evaluated across Deny/Ask/Allow lists, with prefix matching disabled for shell-substitution constructs so they require exact matches.

Request Review (always ask, sandbox off), Default (terminal sandbox on; ask outside), Auto (auto-evaluate outside-sandbox commands; safe reversible ones proceed), Turbo (unrestricted commands, full filesystem, MCP/web allowed); set globally, per project, or from the message box.

Native OS sandbox for agent commands — sandbox-exec on macOS, kernel namespaces on Linux, process security environments on Windows — restricted to workspace + temp dirs with no network access; outside-sandbox commands prompt or are auto-evaluated.

CLI modes: default (inline diff review before edits), accept-edits (auto-approve workspace edits), auto (edits plus sandboxed/safe commands auto-approved), plan (prepends /plan: read-only analysis then a structured execution outline for approval); cycle with Shift+Tab, --mode, or /config.

Agents work in projects defining accessible folders, scoped settings and permissions (multi-folder access), with native Git worktree isolation; CLI uses default-cli-project with --project/--new-project, /resume --conversation, and /fork.
Permissions manually granted during a conversation can persist, letting the agent learn trusted actions over time.

Author custom skills as SKILL.md (workspace .agents/skills/; global ~/.gemini/skills/ or ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills/); GEMINI.md/AGENTS.md workspace and global context rules continue to be honored.
/plugin manages installed Marketplace plugins and creates/configures custom plugin bundles; plugins can bundle agents, skills, and slash commands.

First-launch onboarding auto-converts legacy configs, migrates session tokens to the OS keyring, and agy plugin import gemini converts Gemini CLI extensions to native plugins (commands become skills, MCP servers migrate).
Connect stdio/SSE MCP servers via dedicated mcp_config.json profiles (global ~/.gemini/config/ and workspace .agents/), using the serverUrl schema; per-server/tool mcp() permission rules apply.

Curated bundles of skills, MCP servers, and extensions built with Google product teams: Firebase, Android, Modern Web, Chrome DevTools, Flutter, Google Cloud Data, Maps, Science, and the Antigravity SDK.
Live transcription of spoken prompts via the mic icon next to text input boxes (raw audio no longer passed to the model).

Conversation search/switch picker (Cmd+K), /resume, /rewind, /fork; CLI sessions use the conversation's project, and agents ask before touching files outside the workspace (allowNonWorkspaceAccess opt-in).
Common settings (including agent permissions) are shared between the App and CLI, so permission configuration in one applies to both.
Run agy non-interactively (-p/--print) to script agent tasks, integrate with CI pipelines, and capture machine-readable output.

settings.json (~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/), /keybindings, Vim editor mode, color scheme and Alt-Screen/Inline rendering modes, plus a custom status line and window title driven by piped live agent-metadata JSON.

Free plan at $0/month with a meaningful weekly quota; Google AI Plus/Pro/Ultra add 5-hour and weekly limits (Ultra highest, with third-party model access); Pro/Ultra can buy AI credits for overage at Gemini Enterprise consumption pricing; no BYOK and no custom-contract org tiers.

Gemini Enterprise: corporate SSO and BYOID via Workforce Identity Federation, US/EU regional data residency, VPC Service Controls, request/response and telemetry logging, license or pay-as-you-go Agent Platform API billing, and a no-model-training guarantee.
Listed capability across surfaces in the official product comparison; the 2.0 launch blog describes Remote Control as an upcoming launch.
